exercises.prompt: Say in English: Sou responsável por validar os resultados.
exercises.model: I'm responsible for validating the results.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Ela é responsável pelo relatório mensal.
exercises.model: She's responsible for the monthly report.

exercises.prompt: Complete naturally: In this project, I ___ responsible for the validation process.
exercises.model: In this project, I'm responsible for the validation process.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Eu preciso de mais informações sobre o processo.
exercises.model: I need more information about the process.

exercises.prompt: Make this natural: We received many useful informations from the users.
exercises.model: We received a lot of useful information from the users.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Essa informação ajudou a esclarecer a regra de negócio.
exercises.model: This information helped clarify the business rule.

patterns.label: data
patterns.note: Avoid datas. In professional English, data is normally used without a plural -s.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Esses dados vêm do SAP.
exercises.model: This data comes from SAP.

exercises.prompt: Make this natural: These datas are used in the dashboard.
exercises.model: This data is used in the dashboard.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Eu comparei os dados de duas fontes diferentes.
exercises.model: I compared data from two different sources.

patterns.label: to + verb
patterns.note: After to, use the base form of the verb.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Eu criei uma regra para validar os dados.
exercises.model: I created a rule to validate the data.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Nós automatizamos o processo para economizar tempo.
exercises.model: We automated the process to save time.

exercises.prompt: Make this natural: I use SQL for validate the results.
exercises.model: I use SQL to validate the results.

patterns.label: responsible for + -ing
patterns.note: After responsible for, use a noun or verb ending in -ing.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Sou responsável por revisar as exceções.
exercises.model: I'm responsible for reviewing the exceptions.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Minha equipe é responsável por monitorar o processo.
exercises.model: My team is responsible for monitoring the process.

exercises.prompt: Make this natural: I'm responsible to check the dashboard every morning.
exercises.model: I'm responsible for checking the dashboard every morning.

patterns.label: past tense
patterns.note: When the event is finished in the past, keep the main verbs in the past.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Ontem eu validei o arquivo e encontrei uma divergência.
exercises.model: Yesterday I validated the file and found a discrepancy.

exercises.prompt: Change to the past: I review the requirement and talk to the user.
exercises.model: I reviewed the requirement and talked to the user.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: No projeto passado, eu desenvolvi a lógica e testei os resultados.
exercises.model: In the previous project, I developed the logic and tested the results.

patterns.label: since + present perfect
patterns.note: For something that started in the past and continues now, use have/has + past participle, often with since or for.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Eu trabalho com dados desde 2022.
exercises.model: I have been working with data since 2022.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Estou trabalhando neste projeto há três meses.
exercises.model: I have been working on this project for three months.

exercises.prompt: Make this natural: I work with Snowflake since last year.
exercises.model: I have been working with Snowflake since last year.

patterns.label: he/she/it + -s
patterns.note: In the present simple, he/she/it normally takes -s on the verb.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: A solução resolve o problema.
exercises.model: The solution solves the problem.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: O dashboard mostra as principais exceções.
exercises.model: The dashboard shows the main exceptions.

exercises.prompt: Make this natural: The process reduce manual work.
exercises.model: The process reduces manual work.

patterns.label: role is to + verb
patterns.note: After expressions such as my role is, use to + base verb for purpose/responsibility.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Meu papel é entender as regras de negócio.
exercises.model: My role is to understand the business rules.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Meu objetivo é reduzir o trabalho manual.
exercises.model: My goal is to reduce manual work.

exercises.prompt: Make this natural: My responsibility is validate the final output.
exercises.model: My responsibility is to validate the final output.

patterns.label: finish with impact
patterns.note: Close professional answers with a clear result or business impact.

exercises.prompt: Complete this answer with an impact: I automated the validation process, and as a result...
exercises.model: I automated the validation process, and as a result, the team spent less time on manual checks.

exercises.prompt: Complete professionally: I consolidated the data into one reliable source. This helped the team...
exercises.model: I consolidated the data into one reliable source. This helped the team investigate discrepancies faster and make decisions with more confidence.

exercises.prompt: Say in English: Como resultado, reduzimos o trabalho manual e melhoramos a consistência do processo.
exercises.model: As a result, we reduced manual work and improved the consistency of the process.
